title: OK Falls Half Day Wine Tour- Incl. Tasting Fees & Guide Gratuity!
includes: Door to door pick up and drop off in Okanagan Falls Area
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Okanagan Falls is a hidden treasure in the South Okanagan, perfect for cool climate wines like sparkling wine, Gewurztraminer, and Riesling. This charming wine trail attracts wine lovers from all over, with its picturesque vineyards and boutique wineries just a hop away from Penticton. Hop on one of our Okanagan Falls Wine Tours along Corkscrew Drive and soak in the stunning views and delightful wines. On this half day wine tour you will have the chance to visit 4 award winning vineyards with complementary tastings at each. We’ll pick you up and drop you off from Penticton, Kaleden, or Okanagan Falls, and keep you refreshed and comfy with bottled water and air-conditioned rides. Cheers to a wine adventure you won’t forget!
